universe_basis: Fixed current S&P 500 constituent snapshot and current GICS labels; all 500 distinct current issuers attempted, not historical membership

XOM.reason: Current snapshot uses successor CIK 2115436 with filings starting in 2026; legacy Exxon Mobil CIK 34088 holds study-period filings.

DIS.reason: Pre-2019 Disney entity; current CIK 1744489 begins after the Disney-Fox reorganization

AVGO.reason: Broadcom Limited predecessor before April 4, 2018 redomiciliation to Delaware; one-for-one exchange retained AVGO identity. Does not append unrelated pre-merger Broadcom Corp history.

APO.reason: Apollo AAM Class A shares exchanged one-for-one for successor AGM shares in January 2022 Apollo-Athene merger. Adds Apollo predecessor only, not separate Athene releases; business reporting perimeter changed.

APA.reason: Apache Corporation predecessor before March 1,2021 APA holding-company reorganization; one-for-one common share exchange and unchanged APA ticker.

BLK.reason: Old BlackRock predecessor before October 1,2024 holding-company reorganization accompanying GIP acquisition; one-for-one share exchange retained BLK ticker. Reporting perimeter changed.

BG.reason: Bunge Limited predecessor before November 1,2023 Swiss redomiciliation; one-for-one exchange retained BG ticker and operating business.

CI.reason: Old Cigna shares exchanged one-for-one for successor New Cigna on December 20,2018. Adds Cigna predecessor only, not Express Scripts history or retrospective pro forma results; reporting perimeter changed.

FERG.reason: Ferguson plc one-for-one successor reorganization effective August 1,2024; same operating business. Earlier SEC history may be limited because US listing began March 2021.

EVRG.reason: Westar Energy is the accounting acquirer/reporting predecessor of Evergy; Westar shares exchanged one-for-one on June 4,2018. Adds Westar only, not separate Great Plains history. Reporting perimeter expands after merger.

LIN.reason: Praxair is accounting acquirer and reporting predecessor of Linde; Praxair shares exchanged one-for-one on October 31,2018. Adds Praxair only, not German Linde AG standalone history or retrospective pro forma results. Reporting perimeter changed.

MRVL.reason: Marvell Technology Group Ltd shares exchanged one-for-one for successor Marvell Technology Inc on April20,2021. Adds Marvell predecessor only, not Inphi prior history; reporting perimeter changed.

STE.reason: STERIS UK holding-company shares exchanged one-for-one for Irish successor effective March28,2019. Adds same-business UK predecessor only; no inferred unrelated legacy issuer.

TPL.reason: Texas Pacific Land Trust transferred all assets, employees and liabilities to successor corporation effective January11,2021; one-for-one share exchange. Preserves trust-to-corporation continuity with structural-change disclosure.
